description: This file defines the GZIPRequestStream class, which extends ServletInputStream to provide GZIP decompression of the request input stream in a web application filter context.

classes.name: GZIPRequestStream
classes.description: A custom ServletInputStream that wraps a GZIPInputStream to provide decompressed data from an HTTP request.

methods.name: GZIPRequestStream
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the GZIPInputStream with the request's input stream.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Reads decompressed data into a byte array.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Reads a single byte of decompressed data.

methods.name: isFinished
methods.description: Indicates whether all the data has been read from the stream; unsupported here, throws exception.

methods.name: isReady
methods.description: Indicates if the stream is ready to be read; unsupported here, throws exception.

methods.name: setReadListener
methods.description: Sets a ReadListener for asynchronous reading; unsupported here, throws exception.
